name: v28-40-mobile-touch-longpress
objective: ui-rework owed row: on a phone-width viewport (run with ST_DEBUG_VIEWPORT=390x844) a real CDP touch long-press on a Studio graph checkpoint opens only the Checkpoint actions sheet (not the editor sheet underneath); Edit checkpoint opens the editor, an objective edit is saved to the library and applied to this chat, the Studio closes clean and the runner restores the library and deletes the chat. No model.

requires.why: Studio touch input, save and apply only.

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; if (innerWidth >= 700) throw new Error('run with ST_DEBUG_VIEWPORT=390x844: viewport is ' + innerWidth + ' px wide'); return { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight };

globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const start = document.querySelector('#so-briefing-start'); if (start && start.offsetParent) start.click(); return { briefingDismissed: Boolean(start) };

const until = Date.now() + 10000; const cy = () => document.querySelector('#so-studio-modal [data-so="graph-canvas"]')?._cyreg?.cy; while (!(cy()?.getElementById('gate')?.length && cy()?.getElementById('road')?.length) && Date.now() < until) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); if (!cy()?.getElementById('gate')?.length) throw new Error('graph nodes missing'); const sheets = [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-studio-modal [role="region"]')].map((r) => r.getAttribute('aria-label')); if (sheets.includes('Checkpoint actions') || sheets.includes('checkpoint editor')) throw new Error('a sheet is already open: ' + sheets); return { nodes: cy().nodes().length, narrow: matchMedia('(max-width: 699px)').matches };

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const region = (name) => [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-studio-modal [role="region"]')].find((r) => r.getAttribute('aria-label') === name && r.offsetParent !== null); const actions = region('Checkpoint actions'); if (!actions) throw new Error('long-press did not open Checkpoint actions: ' + JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('#so-studio-modal [role="region"]')].map((r) => r.getAttribute('aria-label')))); if (!actions.querySelector('h3')?.textContent.includes('The Gate')) throw new Error('actions sheet names ' + actions.querySelector('h3')?.textContent); if (region('checkpoint editor')) throw new Error('the release after a long-press also opened the checkpoint editor over the actions sheet'); const labels = [...actions.querySelectorAll('button')].map((b) => b.textContent.trim()); for (const want of ['Edit checkpoint', 'Connect from here', 'Remove checkpoint', 'Back to graph']) if (!labels.includes(want)) throw new Error('missing action ' + want + ': ' + labels); const top = document.elementFromPoint(...(() => { const b = actions.querySelector('button').getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.left + b.width / 2, b.top + b.height / 2]; })()); if (!actions.contains(top)) throw new Error('actions sheet is covered at its first button'); return { actions: labels };

const region = (name) => [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-studio-modal [role="region"]')].find((r) => r.getAttribute('aria-label') === name && r.offsetParent !== null); const actions = region('Checkpoint actions'); [...actions.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Edit checkpoint').click(); const until = Date.now() + 5000; while (!region('checkpoint editor') && Date.now() < until) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const editor = region('checkpoint editor'); if (!editor) throw new Error('Edit checkpoint did not open the editor'); const area = editor.querySelector('textarea'); if (!area || area.value !== 'Begin at the gate.') throw new Error('editor is not on the gate: ' + area?.value); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(area, 'Begin at the gate, touched on a phone.'); area.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const draft = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState(); const gate = draft.draft.checkpoints.find((c) => c.id === 'gate'); if (gate.objective !== 'Begin at the gate, touched on a phone.') throw new Error('edit did not reach the draft: ' + gate.objective); [...editor.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Back to graph').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (region('checkpoint editor') || region('Checkpoint actions')) throw new Error('Back to graph left a sheet open'); if (draft.errors?.length) throw new Error('draft invalid: ' + JSON.stringify(draft.errors)); return { objective: gate.objective };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const playing = rt.getStory()?.checkpointById?.gate?.objective; if (playing !== 'Begin at the gate, touched on a phone.') throw new Error('save did not apply to this chat: ' + playing); const library = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].stories ?? []; const record = (Array.isArray(library) ? library : Object.values(library)).find((r) => (r.id ?? r.story?.id ?? r.raw?.id) === 'so-m40-touch'); if (!record || !JSON.stringify(record).includes('touched on a phone')) throw new Error('library record missing the edit'); return { applied: playing, library: true, identity: rt.getSnapshot().storyIdentity };

const open = document.querySelector('#so-studio-modal'); if (open && open.open) throw new Error('studio still open'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); delete globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse; return { studioClosed: true };
